meta.title: ShrimpPulse — Aquaculture knowledge, closer to the farm
meta.description: ShrimpPulse is an AI assistant for shrimp aquaculture on LINE. Version 2.0 offers expert-reviewed antibiotic and chemical usage guidance; version 4.0 is in development.

hero.eyebrow: AI assistant for shrimp aquaculture · on LINE
hero.headline: Aquaculture knowledge, closer to the farm.
hero.lead: ShrimpPulse is an AI assistant focused on shrimp aquaculture. It helps farmers, technicians, and aquaculture professionals access expert-reviewed knowledge about responsible antibiotic and chemical use, through a platform many farms already use every day: LINE.
hero.audience: For Thai shrimp farmers, farm technicians, aquaculture professionals, researchers, and anyone curious about the project.
hero.mascotAlt: The ShrimpPulse mascot: a friendly red shrimp in a lab coat and tie, holding a clipboard.

items.title: ShrimpPulse 2.0
items.text: Publicly released April 2026. Antibiotic and chemical usage guidance on LINE. Free to use.

items.title: ShrimpPulse 4.0
items.text: In development since August 2026. Adds disease and prevention guidance with a loop-agent architecture. Not yet publicly available.

items.title: Later additions
items.text: Standard farm management is a planned addition. Explanatory images are under consideration.

why.title: From resistance research to a farm-side reference
why.text: ShrimpPulse began with research on antibiotic resistance in bacteria isolated from commercial fishery products. Findings involving antibiotics that matter in human medicine made the link between aquaculture, food systems, and human health tangible. The project is an attempt to bring relevant, reviewed knowledge to the people making everyday decisions on farms.

capabilities.title: What you can use today, and what is being built

now.title: ShrimpPulse 2.0 today
items: Antibiotic usage guidance drawn from an expert-reviewed pharmacological knowledge base.
Chemical usage guidance drawn from the same expert-reviewed knowledge base.
A flow-agent approach with knowledge-base retrieval, delivered through LINE at no charge.

next.title: ShrimpPulse 4.0 in development
items: A third module on disease diagnosis and prevention guidance, currently being refined before expert review and field testing.
A loop-agent architecture that can identify the type of question, choose resources or skills, retrieve in several steps, and check intermediate results.
Connecting related issues across disease, treatment, prevention, and farm conditions.

capabilities.note: Disease and prevention guidance is part of 4.0 development and is not available in the public 2.0 release.

how.title: Retrieve first, then answer
how.text: ShrimpPulse 2.0 uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation: it first finds relevant material in a curated knowledge base and then formulates an answer from it, like consulting an organised reference library before replying. ShrimpPulse 4.0 is being built as a loop agent that can retrieve, assess, and retrieve again when evidence is insufficient.

roadmap.title: Where the project is heading
roadmap.text: The September 2026 proposal sets out feedback analysis, prototyping, expert review, and a field pilot ahead of a proposed public release of 4.0 in March 2027. These dates are targets and remain subject to validation and revision.

milestones.title: Proposed public release of 4.0, subject to validation
